title.purpose: Page titles and KPI values; the largest text in the product, capped at 20px.

body.purpose: The 14px working size for almost all dashboard text.

label.purpose: Badges, table headers, hints, and timestamps at 12px medium.

mono.purpose: URLs and identifiers in scan and prospect views.

site-title.purpose: Marketing site h1 headings in the system Arial stack, 24px bold.

site-body.purpose: Marketing site document text at browser-default 16px Arial.

shadows.name: floating-layer
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the product, the Tailwind shadow-xl preset; dialogs and dropdown menu panels only, always with a line-strong border.

motion.name: ease-emphasis
motion.purpose: The decelerating curve for page, content, and drawer entrances.

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Route entrance: fade plus 6px rise; replayed on every navigation.

motion.name: content-in
motion.purpose: Dialog entrance: fade plus scale from 0.97.

motion.name: drawer-in
motion.purpose: Mobile navigation drawer slides in from the left.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton loading sweep, a 110deg white 5 percent gradient over the raised surface.

motion.name: progress-indeterminate
motion.purpose: One-third-wide white segment slides across the track for work with no real target.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Buttons transition everything in 150ms and scale to 0.98 when active; inputs and nav use color-only transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Motion is decoration only; every state must be fully readable without it.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar appears, mobile top bar and drawer disappear, content padding widens.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: KPI grid goes from 2 to 4 columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: White surface with near-black label; the brightest object on screen and the only filled accent surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-accent, #f2f3f5); color: #08090a; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong, #d3d6db); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #f2f3f5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised graphite surface with a strong hairline border; the quiet companion to the white primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.13)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-raised, #17181a); color: var(--color-ink, #f7f8f8); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-overlay, #1e1f23); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #f2f3f5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No surface until hovered; soft steel label that brightens on interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #9fa5ae); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-raised, #17181a); color: var(--color-ink, #f7f8f8); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #f2f3f5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Outlined alert red on transparent; reserved for destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(235 87 87 / 0.4); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-danger, #eb5757); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgb(235 87 87 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #f2f3f5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 36px raised graphite field with hairline border; focus brightens the border and adds a soft white ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-raised, #17181a); color: var(--color-ink, #f7f8f8); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; outline: none; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-muted, #7b808a); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgb(242 243 245 / 0.7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(242 243 245 / 0.25); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Severity Badge
components.description: Small tinted chip; the 15 percent background plus full-strength text is how severity color is allowed on large surfaces.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-critical { background: rgb(242 85 95 / 0.15); color: var(--color-sev-critical, #f2555f); } .ds-badge-neutral { background: rgb(123 128 138 / 0.15); color: var(--color-ink-soft, #9fa5ae); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Panel charcoal container on the near-black base, separated by a 7 percent hairline and no shadow.
components.html:
Recent audits

Scans run in the last 30 days.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-panel, #101112); padding: 20px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #f7f8f8); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.43; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.33; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #7b808a); }

components.name: KPI Tile
components.description: Signature dashboard primitive: muted label over a large tight-tracked value inside a bordered panel tile.
components.css: .ds-kpi { border: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-panel, #101112); padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-label { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.33; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #7b808a); } .ds-kpi-value { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--color-ink, #f7f8f8); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Raised pill container of flat segments; the selected segment gains the white tint, not a filled background.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-raised, #17181a); padding: 4px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-seg-item { border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #7b808a); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: var(--color-ink-soft, #9fa5ae); } .ds-seg-on, .ds-seg-on:hover { background: var(--color-accent-tint, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09)); color: var(--color-ink, #f7f8f8); } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #f2f3f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Floating overlay panel with the one allowed shadow, strong hairline border, and raised item hover.
components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 176px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.13)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-overlay, #1e1f23); padding: 4px; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; background: transparent; text-align: left; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.43; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #9fa5ae); cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-active { background: var(--color-raised, #17181a); color: var(--color-ink, #f7f8f8); }

narrative.overview:
Odysseus sells findings a client can check, so both surfaces are places evidence is examined: the operator reads it in the dashboard, the prospect reads it on the site. That is what the North Star asks of any new screen: show what is actually known, never a number nobody can stand behind, and state the limit before the strength. A blank where a value failed to load is honest; a confident zero is not.

The dashboard looks the part of a single-operator tool: a near-black, layered monochrome interface in the same family as Linear or Vercel's consoles. Surfaces stack from base through panel, raised, and overlay, separated by 7 percent white hairlines rather than shadows. The accent is white. Primary actions are the brightest object on screen, which means hierarchy is carried by brightness steps and typography, never by brand color. The only chromatic colors in the product are the four severity shades shared with the PDF report, plus a danger red for destructive and error states.

The marketing site is a different, deliberately spartan world. It is a standalone Next.js deploy with no component library and no webfonts: white or near-black pages (switched by the OS color scheme preference) typeset in the system Arial stack, single-column legal and informational documents. The site intentionally depends on nothing in the workspace, so it shares no tokens with the dashboard; it is recorded here as its own minimal surface.

Motion is decoration only. Entrances use short, decelerating fades and slides (0.2 to 0.3 seconds, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), a prefers-reduced-motion rule collapses all of it, and every state stays fully readable without animation. Accessibility posture is visible in the base layer: a global 2px white focus outline, AA-contrast text pairs in both directions of the monochrome theme, and dark color-scheme declared at the root.
keyCharacteristics: Layered near-black monochrome surfaces with hairline borders; depth by lightness, not shadow.
The accent is white; color appears only as severity, at small sizes or 15 percent tints.

One typeface, typeset small: 14px body baseline, 20px page titles as the ceiling. Inter is the intended face and is self-hosted, but the built dashboard currently 404s its woff2 files and falls back to the system stack (see Observed Inconsistencies 5).
Genuinely flat: shadow belongs only to floating layers (dialogs, dropdown menus, toasts).
Radius ladder: 12px containers, 8px controls, 6px chips, full pills only for progress and dots.
Short decelerating motion, decoration only, killed entirely under reduced motion.

rules.name: The White Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent is white; there is no brand hue anywhere in the dashboard chrome. Hierarchy comes from brightness steps, borders, and type.

rules.name: The Severity Monopoly Rule
rules.body: Chromatic color is reserved for severity and danger. Severity color appears as text, as 8px dots, or as 15 percent tinted badge backgrounds, never as large filled surfaces.

rules.name: The One Grey Ladder Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy uses exactly three greys: ink for what matters, ink-soft for content, ink-muted for labels and hints.

rules.name: The 14px Baseline Rule
rules.body: The dashboard is typeset at 14px; sizes above it are reserved for page titles, dialog titles, and KPI values, and nothing exceeds 20px.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only when a layer floats above the page, and it is always the same preset.

dos: Do address colors by token name (panel, line, ink-soft); the hex values in the frontmatter are the normative source for those names.
Do keep body text at 14px and push secondary content down the grey ladder (ink for what matters, ink-soft for content, ink-muted for labels and hints).
Do reserve severity color for text, 8px dots, and 15 percent tinted badges; match the PDF report's shade exactly.
Do give floating layers (dialog, dropdown) both a line-strong border and the shadow preset; they never appear separately.
Do use the named keyframe animations (page-in, overlay-in, content-in, drawer-in) with the cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) curve for entrances, and keep state readable with animations disabled.
Do keep the focus system: global 2px accent outline with 2px offset; inputs add the 70 percent border plus 25 percent ring.
donts: Don't introduce a brand hue into dashboard chrome; white is the accent and severity is the only color.
Don't put shadows on resting surfaces (cards, tiles, buttons, tables); shadow means floating.
Don't typeset above 20px; below 14px the steps are 13, 12, and the single 11px micro-label in the report preparation card.
Don't fill large areas with severity colors; full-strength chroma belongs to text and dots only.
Don't import dashboard tokens into the site or treat the site as themed; it is deliberately standalone with its own two-color scheme-swap system.
Don't replace the wordmark with a logo mark; the brand is the name, set in semibold Inter.
